investigation.finding: Initial image fixture awaited decode without driving scheduled frames; interrupted and corrected to drive widget frames alongside real I/O using the existing artwork helper pattern.

The full-Home renderer decoded artwork while driving frames in runAsync, creating its timer in the real-time zone; virtual time snapshots did not advance it. After warming images, the fixture restarts motion through Reduce motion on/off before sampling. Production pan logic was unchanged for this harness correction; the final renderer asserts the right crop.

Renderer cases passed after the timer harness correction. The old Z-row geometry expectation then failed after the requested Shift-width change; the expected columns were updated and both two-column Shift widths are asserted. Final regressions pass.
